title: Club Membership: billing freeze duration, fee, and frequency basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which a Club Membership contract may be placed on a billing freeze: the maximum duration of a single freeze, the fee charged for initiating one, the cap on how many freezes may be initiated in a rolling year, and whether dues keep accruing during a freeze.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Maximum duration of a single freeze | Freezes allowed in a rolling 12-month window | Fee to initiate a freeze |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 90 calendar days | 1 | $10.00 |
| Student Metro Access | 90 calendar days | 2 | $0.00 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 90 calendar days | 1 | $10.00 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 120 calendar days | 2 | $10.00 |
| Premier All-Access | 120 calendar days | 2 | $0.00 |
| Black Card All-Access | 180 calendar days | 3 | $0.00 |
| Founding Legacy Access | 180 calendar days | 3 | $0.00 |

## Rule
A freeze may last up to the tier's own maximum duration figure. The freeze fee shown above is charged when a freeze is initiated, unless the medical-hold dues waiver applies to a documented medical hold, in which case the freeze fee is waived. Dues continue to accrue during a freeze unless the medical-hold dues waiver applies.

## Rolling frequency cap
A member may not initiate more freezes in a rolling 12-month window than the tier's own cap shown above. This count takes every freeze-initiated event on record for that same membership contract in the trailing 365 days ending at the moment the freeze is being requested, and compares that count against the tier's own cap before a further freeze is allowed.

## Medical-hold dues waiver eligibility
Across every Club Membership tier, dues may be waived while frozen for a documented medical hold. Where this basis applies, both the freeze fee and continued dues accrual during the freeze are set aside for that freeze; where it does not apply, the freeze fee shown above is charged and dues continue to accrue for the freeze's duration.

## Points of judgement
A member whose prior freezes in the trailing 365 days already equal the tier's own rolling-year cap may not initiate a further freeze until enough of that window has elapsed to drop below the cap again.
